# Eco-Friendly Kitchen Appliances — Frequently Asked Questions

## 1. General Overview
**1. What is the new eco-friendly appliance line?**  
A collection of high-performance kitchen appliances (blenders, coffee makers, air fryers, toasters, kettles, and cookware) engineered with recycled materials, energy-efficient motors, and plastic-free packaging.

**2. Which specific products are included?**  
The launch includes the EcoBlend Pro, EcoBrew 360, EcoAir Crisp, EcoToast 2-Slice, EcoKettle Smart, and a ceramic non-stick cookware set.

**3. What makes them “eco-friendly”?**  
They use recycled aluminum/stainless steel bodies, bio-based coatings, low-energy motors, minimal standby power draw, and 100% recyclable/compostable packaging.

**4. Are they available globally?**  
Yes, with region-specific voltage and certification variants. Check your local store locator for availability.

**5. What materials are used in construction?**  
Recycled stainless steel (minimum 60%), recycled aluminum, bio-resin handles, and ceramic or plant-based non-stick coatings—free of PFAS, BPA, and phthalates.

**6. Do they contain harmful chemicals?**  
No. All food-contact surfaces are certified food-safe and free of lead, cadmium, PFAS, BPA, and phthalates.

**7. Are the products vegan/cruelty-free?**  
Yes. No animal-derived materials or animal testing are used in design, manufacture, or packaging.

**8. What colors/finishes are available?**  
Matte Sage, Warm Sand, Brushed Steel, and Soft Charcoal.

**9. Is there a smart/app-enabled version?**  
The EcoKettle Smart and EcoBlend Pro include app connectivity for scheduling and energy tracking; others are manual with LED indicators.

**10. Where are they manufactured?**  
Designed in-house; assembled in facilities certified B Corp and ISO 14001, with supply chain transparency reports published annually.

---

## 2. Eco-Friendly Features & Sustainability
**11. What is the carbon footprint of manufacturing?**  
We publish third-party verified life-cycle assessments (LCAs) per product; all fall 30–45% below industry averages for comparable appliances.

**12. Are recycled materials used?**  
Yes—post-consumer recycled metals and glass; packaging uses 80% post-consumer recycled paper/cardboard.

**13. What percentage is recycled content?**  
Appliance bodies contain 60–85% recycled metal; packaging is 100% recyclable/compostable.

**14. Are they Energy Star certified?**  
Yes, all electric models carry Energy Star and EU Energy Label A++ ratings where applicable.

The EcoBrew 360 uses a closed-loop rinse cycle, cutting water use by ~40% versus traditional drip machines.

Entirely plastic-free for the product box and inner protection; only small adhesive strips contain minimal recycled content.

Replacement parts (blades, filters, seals) use recycled or bio-based materials where technically feasible.

Use our Take-Back Program: ship it back free, or drop off at a partner recycler; 95% of materials are recoverable.

Yes. Trade in any old appliance (any brand) for a discount on your new purchase; old units are refurbished or recycled.

**21. What certifications do you hold?**  
Energy Star, B Corp, LEED Gold (manufacturing), Cradle to Cradle Certified Bronze, and FSC for packaging.

**22. Are the products carbon neutral?**  
Operations are carbon neutral via verified offsets; we are working toward full product-level carbon neutrality by 2027.

Yes—tested against top-tier conventional models for speed, capacity, and consistency; they often exceed standards due to optimized motor and heating designs.

EcoBlend Pro: 30 sec smoothie; EcoAir Crisp: 12 min at 375°F; EcoKettle: boil 1L in ~3.5 min.

All operate below 70 dB; EcoBlend Pro runs at 65 dB with a redesigned sound-dampening base.

Built for residential and light-commercial use with reinforced gears, thermal safeguards, and 2-year heavy-use warranties.

No—standard stainless steel, cast iron, and ceramic cookware work; avoid microwave-only plastics.

Only with the cookware set’s hardened ceramic coating; on appliances, use silicone/wood to preserve surfaces.

**29. Are there preset programs?**  
Yes—smoothie, soup, dough, coffee strength, toast darkness, air-fry preset, and boil temperature.

Yes. All digital models allow full manual control via dials or app.

**31. Do they have child locks?**  
Yes, one-touch child-lock settings on all electric units; cookware is naturally cool-touch handled.

Adjustable altitude settings on the EcoBrew and EcoKettle; other units are unaffected.

Damp microfiber cloth and mild soap; avoid abrasive pads that scratch recycled-metal finishes.

5-year coating warranty; if it degrades under normal use, we replace the part or refund.

Yes—all electric models run on standard 110–240V; low startup surge makes them solar-friendly.

Yes—partner retailers in 200+ cities have live demo stations; check locator.

2-year full warranty; 5-year on motors/heating; 10-year structural guarantee.

Certified repair partners in all major regions; in-house support handles replacements directly.

Yes—up to 5-year extended protection available at purchase.

Chat and email: 24/7; phone: 6am–midnight ET; multilingual options available.

Similar or better performance metrics; lower energy/water use; longer warranties; fully recyclable packaging; transparent sourcing.

Dimensions listed for each; they align with standard 24-inch countertop and 18-inch cabinet depths.

Standard plugs and plumbing; no special outlets needed.

EcoKettle and EcoBlend work with Alexa, Google Home, and Apple HomeKit; others use simple Bluetooth.

Yes—“Kitchen Starter” (blender + kettle + cookware) saves 20%; “Brew & Crisp” saves 15%.
